vision: A standalone, headless Decimal calculation engine for leveraged crypto trading — salvaged from the retired TradingDashboard app so the rebuild depends on it instead of reimplementing leverage, DCA, and hedging math.

calculators.description: Port the pure risk/hedging calculators out of the retired TradingDashboard app into DeltaCalc.*

v0_1.name: Standalone calc engine
v0_1.description: Proves the salvaged calculators run standalone (no Phoenix/Ecto/I-O) with their original test suites green, so the TradingDashboard rebuild can depend on DeltaCalc instead of reimplementing the math.

task.title: Scaffold delta_calc library
acceptance_criteria: mix deps.get && mix compile --warnings-as-errors succeeds
mix test passes
git repo initialised at ~/_DATA/code/delta_calc
task.body: Create a standalone Elixir library (no --sup, no Phoenix) for the salvaged calculators: mix.exs with {:decimal, "~> 2.0"} + dev/test tooling mirroring the source project (stream_data, credo, dialyxir, doctor, styler, sobelow, ex_unit_json, dialyzer_json, ex_doc); precommit aliases; .tool-versions; README + moduledoc describing the planned API surface; git init for a clean break from the dead project.
task.implemented: Scaffolded ~/_DATA/code/delta_calc via `mix new --module DeltaCalc`; customised mix.exs (deps + precommit/precommit.full aliases + dialyzer/coverage config), lib/delta_calc.ex moduledoc (API surface), README, .tool-versions (1.19.1-otp-28 / erlang 28.4), .doctor.exs (hand-written for doctor 0.22 whose gen.config is broken under Elixir 1.20), .gitignore (+priv/plts). `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` clean; `mix test` green; git initialised.

task.title: Backfill tests for PositionCalculator, DCAPlanner, Hedging
acceptance_criteria: calculate_position/2 and calculate_dca_ladder/1 each have dedicated passing tests
DeltaCalc.Hedging fully covered incl. boundary cases
Overall coverage >= 80% (>= 95% on Calc/Hedging money math)
No test hides errors (explicit flunk on unexpected branches)
task.body: PositionCalculator and DCAPlanner shipped UNTESTED in the source app (only exercised transitively through the LiveView); Hedging is brand new. Write dedicated tests: calculate_position/2 full pipeline (allocation -> notional -> leverage -> safety -> mmr_info) incl. long/short and each risk mode; calculate_dca_ladder/1 defensive + aggressive incl. short conversion; all DeltaCalc.Hedging formulas incl. edge cases (zero spot, 0%/100%/120%+ hedge, nil-safe boundaries). Use golden numbers cross-checked against the source behaviour.

task.title: README + API docs + agent manifest + tighten doctor thresholds
acceptance_criteria: README documents each module with a runnable example
DeltaCalc.Manifest.build/0 returns the aggregated api surface; Descripex.MCP.tools/1 lists every public fn
mix descripex.manifest emits a valid api_manifest.json
mix doctor passes at tightened thresholds (100% doc on public API)
ex_doc builds clean (mix docs)
task.body: Capstone after the modules are ported (each already carries its api() declarations). 1) README: real usage examples per module (input shapes + sample Decimal outputs). 2) Confirm every public fn has @doc + @spec. 3) Aggregate the per-module Descripex api() surface: add DeltaCalc.Manifest with `build/0` -> Descripex.Manifest.build([DeltaCalc.Calc, .Presets, .DCAPlanner, .PositionCalculator, .Hedging]); expose Descripex.MCP.tools/1 over the same module list so a trading agent can call DeltaCalc as MCP tools; verify `mix descripex.manifest --pretty` emits a clean api_manifest.json. 4) Raise .doctor.exs thresholds from the scaffold's 0 to the project standard (min_overall_doc_coverage 100, real spec floor) now that there is public API to hold to it.
